one_sentence_positioning.value: SaferAI对12家AI公司的前沿安全框架进行系统评估，发现中位得分仅18%，存在显著改进空间。

evidence.quote: This study assesses 12 Frameworks, using 65 weighted criteria, across four dimensions: risk identification, risk analysis & evaluation, risk treatment, and risk governance.

value: 评估12家AI公司的安全框架，使用65项加权标准，覆盖风险识别、分析评估、风险处理、风险治理四个维度
总体得分范围8%-34%，中位数18%；Anthropic(34%)和OpenAI(33%)领先
'同行天花板'(peer ceiling)为54%，表明采纳同行最佳实践可大幅提升
三个核心风险输入普遍薄弱：未知风险识别、风险容忍度定义、失控风险缓解
独立监督机制普遍缺失，12家中7家内部审计参与得分为0%

evidence.quote: Overall scores range from 34% (Anthropic) to 8% (Cohere), with a median of 18%. Many aspects are missing or under-specified... a company adopting all leading practices currently adopted across their peers would score 54%, which is triple the current median.
We assess each Provider against 65 weighted criteria derived from established risk management standards in AI and other high-risk industries.

value: 四维度风险框架评估方法

evidence.quote: We derive our 65 weighted criteria explicitly from Campos et al. (2025), which adapts established risk management standards from high-risk industries (e.g. nuclear power and aviation) to the frontier AI context.

value.reason: 直接评估各公司对失控风险(loss-of-control)的框架覆盖情况，发现相关缓解措施'极度不发达'

evidence.quote: Third, mitigations for loss-of-control risks remain vastly underdeveloped. Instead, Providers typically describe open research directions.

value.reason: 提供行业安全框架的横向对比基准，识别自主性安全治理的关键缺口，对政策研究和框架设计有直接参考价值

evidence.quote: Regulators can evaluate whether Frameworks meet legal requirements and identify gaps warranting additional regulation. Investors can assess exposure to AI-related risks.

open_questions: 欧盟AI法案和加州SB-53对安全框架的实际约束力如何
同行天花板如何从54%进一步提升到更高水平
